bohannon2011.citation: Bohannon RW, Andrews AW. Normal walking speed: a descriptive meta-analysis. Physiotherapy. 2011;97(3):182-189.
bohannon2011.used_for: Adult gait speed grand means by sex and decade. Table 2 reports a 95% CI, not an SD, so sd is blank.

voss2020.citation: Voss S, Joyce J, Biskis A, et al. Normative database of spatiotemporal gait parameters using inertial sensors in typically developing children and young adults. Gait Posture. 2020;80:206-213.
voss2020.used_for: Child self-selected gait speed, cadence, stride length, and double support by the paper's age bands. Step time is not in Table 2. The 11 to 13 stride-length cell could not be read.

bohannon2006tug.citation: Bohannon RW. Reference values for the timed up and go test: a descriptive meta-analysis. J Geriatr Phys Ther. 2006;29(2):64-68.
bohannon2006tug.used_for: TUG grand means by age. Table 2 gives a 95% CI, not an SD, so sd is blank.

bohannon2010sts.citation: Bohannon RW, Bubela DJ, Magasi SR, Wang YC, Gershon RC. Sit-to-stand test: performance and determinants across the age-span. Isokinet Exerc Sci. 2010;18(4):235-240.
bohannon2010sts.used_for: Five-repetition sit-to-stand mean and SD for every age group in Table 1.

springer2007.citation: Springer BA, Marin R, Cyhan T, Roberts H, Gill NW. Normative values for the unipedal stance test with eyes open and closed. J Geriatr Phys Ther. 2007;30(1):8-15.
springer2007.used_for: Single-leg stance, eyes open, best of 3, by age and sex. The parenthesis is labeled SE, so it was not copied into sd.

steadi.citation: CDC STEADI. Assessment: Timed Up and Go (TUG).
steadi.used_for: TUG time at or above which an older adult is at risk for falling.

ewgsop2.citation: Cruz-Jentoft AJ, Bahat G, Bauer J, et al. Sarcopenia: revised European consensus. Age Ageing. 2019;48(1):16-31.
ewgsop2.used_for: Five-rise chair-stand cut-off and gait-speed cut-off for low performance.

awgs2019.citation: Chen LK, et al. Asian Working Group for Sarcopenia: 2019 consensus update. J Am Med Dir Assoc. 2020;21(3):300-307.
awgs2019.used_for: 6 m gait speed and five-time chair-stand cut-offs. Taken from the PubMed abstract; the full text was not opened.

perera2006.citation: Perera S, Mody SH, Woodman RC, Studenski SA. Meaningful change and responsiveness in common physical performance measures in older adults. J Am Geriatr Soc. 2006;54(5):743-749.
perera2006.used_for: Small and substantial meaningful change in gait speed.

nodal-rule.citation: NODAL screening rule (CONTRACT section 4), not a published cut-off.
nodal-rule.used_for: Symmetry index bands and the heel-first contact bands.
